MISHAP.gloss: an unpredictable outcome that is unfortunate
MISHAP.definition: An unpredictable outcome that is unfortunate.
MISHAP.example: If I didn't have bad luck I wouldn't have any luck at all.

SHIP.gloss: a vessel that carries passengers or freight
SHIP.definition: A vessel that carries passengers or freight.

SPAM.definition: Unwanted e-mail (usually of a commercial nature sent out in bulk).

MASH.gloss: to compress with violence, out of natural shape or condition
MASH.definition: To compress with violence, out of natural shape or condition.

SHAM.definition: Something that is a counterfeit; not what it seems to be.

MAP.definition: Make a map of; show or establish the features of details of.

AIM.gloss: point or cause to go towards
AIM.definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards.
AIM.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

HIP.gloss: either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh
HIP.definition: Either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

ASH.gloss: the residue that remains when something is burned
ASH.definition: The residue that remains when something is burned.

HAM.gloss: meat cut from the thigh of a hog
HAM.definition: Meat cut from the thigh of a hog (usually smoked).

MPH.gloss: the ratio of the distance traveled to the time spent traveling
MPH.definition: The ratio of the distance traveled (in miles) to the time spent traveling (in hours).

SPA.gloss: a health resort near a spring or at the seaside
SPA.definition: A health resort near a spring or at the seaside.

AMP.gloss: the basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
AMP.definition: The basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites.
AMP.example: A typical household circuit carries 15 to 50 amps.
